content: सत्त्रम् [सद्-ष्ट्रन्] (usually written सत्रम्) .²1 A sacrificial session, especially one lasting from 13 to 100 days. .²2 A sacrifice in general; त्रेतामपि निबोध त्वं यस्मिन् सत्रं प्रवर्तते <ls>Mb. 3. 149. 23</ls>. .²3 A n oblation, offering, gift. .²4 Liberality, munificence. .²5 Virtue. .²6 A house, residence. .²7 Covering. .²8 Wealth. .²9 A wood, forest; अयमेव मृगव्यसत्रकामः <ls>Ki. 13. 9</ls>. .²10 A tank, pond. .²11 Fraud, cheating. .²12 A place of refuge, asylum, covert. .²13 Gifts made at all times; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²14 Haughtiness, pride; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²15 An assumed form or disguise; छन्नं तथा तं सत्रेण पाण्डवं प्रेक्ष्य भारत <ls>Mb. 4. 38. 40</ls>.
